Closed enum, omission, explicit disabled/required, replace preservation and unknown-wire fail-closed behavior are covered by remote Go and C unit gates.

defaults.note: Create omission, declared disabled, required policy and replace omission semantics are pinned; live disabled/required behavior is distinguished.

propagation.note: Policy reaches both HTTP/1 and per-stream HTTP/2 admission; the mandatory gate precedes all HTTP/2 route selectors and X-Api-Key is stripped before backend submission.

behavior.note: HTTP/1 configured/storeless behavior and HTTP/2 disabled/storeless behavior are live-proven. HTTP/2 configured-store valid, invalid, model-denied and rate-limited runtime cells remain open.

failure.note: 401/403/429/503 mapping and backend non-delivery are covered across unit and live rails, but HTTP/2 configured-store denial bodies, Retry-After and every tier-hit combination are not live-qualified.

admission.note: ASCII and multibyte UTF-8 boundaries, overflow, embedded NUL, invalid UTF-8 at the Go boundary, and the composite-key limit are covered before mutation.

propagation.note: The Go-to-C copy boundary and C ABI capacity are verified, but live sockproxy lookup and routing semantics are not qualified in S02.

failure.note: The vulnerable baseline is RED; the fixed runtime returns HTTP 400 with the field reason and byte-for-byte equivalent normalized full rule state in three runs.
